name: @hierarchidb/tools-fetch-metadata
description: CLI wrapper for fetching and pre-processing geographic metadata using runtime-shared utilities.

scripts.fetch:gadm: node dist/cli.js fetch gadm output gadm.json
scripts.fetch:naturalearth: node dist/cli.js fetch naturalearth output naturalearth.json
scripts.fetch:osm: node dist/cli.js fetch osm output osm.json
scripts.fetch:geoboundaries: node dist/cli.js fetch geoboundaries output geoboundaries.json
scripts.fetch: pnpm run build && pnpm run fetch:gadm && pnpm run fetch:naturalearth && pnpm run fetch:osm && pnpm run fetch:geoboundaries
